method.cuts: focalcut.reel.reference.analyse (ffmpeg scene score > 0.25); shots split again where SigLIP 2 frames 0.5 s apart inside one shot fall under 0.8 cosine similarity (1.0 s apart: 0.72) -- dissolves, timed to about +-0.5 s and left out of the beat statistics
method.music: focalcut.reel.music.analyse on the film's own audio (librosa beat_track, straight-line grid, downbeat phase = the bar phase with the most low-end onset energy); grid_confidence = onset strength on the grid's beats over half-way between them
method.sync: beat_lock: the constant lead of the cuts over the tracked beats that puts most cuts within +-0.045 s of a beat, tested against randomly jittered cuts; when locked, every later figure is measured with the cuts moved by that lead. The tracker's own latency (librosa places a beat on the onset envelope's peak, some 20-50 ms after the attack) is inside that lead. A hard cut is 'on' a beat within +-0.07 s; chance_* is the share a random cut would score; phrase phase from bar-loudness novelty
method.scale: SigLIP 2 zero-shot at 2 fps (reference.SCALES prompts + generic ones), averaged over the shot; not hand-checked
method.moves: focalcut.reel.moves.frames_moves on 10 fps grey frames of the whole film, label() per shot; in/out_ratio = camera speed in the first/last 0.4 s of a moving shot of 2 s or more, over the shot's median speed
method.body: statistics are over 'body' shots: no title, card or black, and before the music ends
